Name: Setup and recruitment
Goal: Complete the cohort to fifteen committed participants and have a working programme environment in place before the first workshop.

Name: Core workshops and data-package delivery
Goal: Deliver the five workshops and the support hours between them so that each participant takes one of their own datasets to a published FAIR data package with a DOI.

Name: Community building and outreach
Goal: Build an active cross-department community of practice around FAIR data and agentic AI workflows that reaches beyond the cohort.

Name: Consolidation sustainability and reporting
Goal: Publish the final data packages capture the programme as a reusable offering and feed the lessons back into the Data Stewardship Network.
